question: Laurel Hubbard representing ________ became the first-ever transgender athlete to take part in the Tokyo 2020 Olympics under the women's 87+ kg weightlifting category.
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Zealand.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **​​Laurel Hubbard**__
 
• ​​Laurel Hubbard representing **New Zealand** became the** first-ever transgender** athlete to take part in the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics under the women's 87+ kg weightlifting category**.
